title: Spicy Korean Noodle Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful stir fry made with Korean noodles, tofu, and a spicy umami sauce. Serve hot and enjoy!
instructions: Cook the Korean noodles according to the package instructions.
Heat 1 tbsp of soy sauce in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the sliced yellow pepper and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the pressed tofu and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the umami sauce, ginger, garlic, and Korean chili flakes.
Pour the sauce over the noodles and vegetables in the pan.
Stir everything together and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the stir fry hot, garnished with sliced green onions if desired.
